title: Careful buying what you can't see in person, save your money
text:
Careful buying what you can't see in person, save your money. I purchased 2 end tables. I've bought 2 here on Amazon and two from Levin furniture a Ashley retailer. The ones from the store arrived flawless. 1 of 2 from Amazon not so much. While shipping it was undamaged. In the box however was many tiles imperfect. Now Amazon cannot simply send replacement tiles so as such you build the table to unpack your tiles and realize there half thickness required of the have nubs left on from the cutting process not sanded down fully which can't be placed in a square hole. Really frustrating to say the least. I wouldn't recommend these off Amazon they are half the cost but seem to be imperfect not meant for retail sale. Almost like Amazon bought up the remaining back stock.

Do yourself a favor and avoid these.
